original: お墓に参る時は、お線香とろうそく、それからお花を忘れずに持っててね。

en.text: When you go visit the grave, don't forget to bring incense and candles, oh, and flowers too.

original: 暑いの苦手なんで、この暑さにはほんと参るわぁ。

en.text: I don't like hot weather, so this heat's really getting to me.
I'm at a loss with Tom.
Tom gets the better of me.
